title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 22
statement: A roll of tape is \(4\) inches in diameter and is wrapped around a ring that is \(2\) inches in diameter. A cross section of the tape is shown in the figure below. The tape is \(0.015\) inches thick. If the tape is completely unrolled, approximately how long would it be? Round your answer to the nearest \(100\) inches.

solutions.text:
The tape occupies an annulus with outer radius \(2\) inches and inner radius \(1\) inch, so its cross-sectional area is \[ \pi(2^2-1^2)=3\pi. \]

When unrolled, this same cross section is a rectangle of thickness \(0.015\) inches and length \(L.\) Thus \[ 0.015L=3\pi, \] so \(L=200\pi\approx628\) inches. Rounded to the nearest \(100\) inches, this is \(600\) inches.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: The tape occupies an annulus with outer radius \(2\) and inner radius \(1\)
Area of tape cross-section equals thickness times total length
